# VaultScaler

> VaultScaler is a private, local-first AI measurement platform for living and controlled systems. It measures with a camera and edge compute, remembers every reading in an immutable local record, and tells you what changed — and how sure it is. Studio Habitat is our live public proof. Founded in 2025.

VaultScaler turns a camera and a small edge computer into an instrument. It measures what is in front of it locally, appends every reading to an immutable local record, and separates real change in the measurement from imaging or framing artifacts — reporting what changed and how confident it is, in measurement language. Prediction is earned from the local record over time; it is never claimed before the evidence supports it. The platform is private by design: capture, measurement, and memory run on hardware the user controls, and nothing is sent anywhere unless the user chooses to.

## Capabilities

### Measure
Local-first, engineering-grade measurement from a fixed camera and on-device vision (e.g. surface coverage, image quality, scene stability), computed on the edge with no required cloud round-trip.

### Remember
An append-only, tamper-evident local record. Every measurement is stored with its timestamp, confidence, and quality flags. Nothing is overwritten; the history itself is the asset and it belongs to the user.

### Catch real change
The platform distinguishes a real movement in the measurement from a lighting or framing artifact and states which it is, with its uncertainty. It does not present a change in the measurement as a change in the organism.

## Markets

Research labs; vineyards; indoor and vertical farms; and other controlled and living systems that can be observed by a fixed camera and benefit from an honest, private, local record.

## Studio Habitat (live public proof)

Studio Habitat is VaultScaler's live, public proof — an AI-assisted phenotyping lab that measures a real living system around the clock and shows its work: surface coverage, image quality, anomaly surprise, and evidence validity, each with its own uncertainty. It is not the company; it is the platform's claims, held to account in public.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is VaultScaler?
VaultScaler is a private, local-first AI measurement platform for living and controlled systems. It measures with a camera and edge compute, remembers every reading in an immutable local record, and reports what changed and how sure it is.

### How does VaultScaler approach claims about living systems?
It treats observation as evidence: local-first capture, measurement validity carried with every reading, and uncertainty made explicit. The goal is to surface what changed and how confident the measurement is — not to promise biological, crop-health, yield, medical, or agricultural outcomes.

### Does VaultScaler predict the future?
Prediction is on the roadmap, not a present-tense claim. A forecast is only offered once the local record is long and clean enough to support it; foresight is earned from the user's own history.

### Is my data private?
Yes. Capture, measurement, and memory run on hardware the user controls. No images or readings are sent anywhere unless the user explicitly chooses to. Privacy is the architecture, not a setting.

### What is Studio Habitat?
Studio Habitat is VaultScaler's live public proof: an AI-assisted phenotyping lab that measures a real living system and shows its work — surface coverage, image quality, anomaly surprise, and evidence validity — with uncertainty-aware measurement that separates real change from measurement artifact.
